description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Use Magic Device 1 rank, base Fortitude save bonus +4

Benefit: With an item that has a 1st level or higher elemental spell with the earth, fire, ice, lightning, water, or wind descriptor in its construction requirements, you can cast Flame Breath with 1 use of this ability, or Lightning Bolt with 2 uses of this ability. You have 1 + 1 more use of this ability per day at base Fortitude save bonus +6, +8, +10, and +12.

system.requirements: Use Magic Device 1 rank, base Fortitude save bonus +4
